content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

This is not a plugin or a hack. It’s a complete commerce stack — a combination of free and paid tools that let you sell Notion templates directly to buyers. The core components: hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets, file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and crypto payments via NOWPayments. The stack is sovereign. You own every piece. No platform can shut you down. No payment processor can reject your currency. This architecture is built for creators in regions where conventional tools fail. It’s not just about selling templates — it’s about owning the infrastructure that makes the sale possible.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how it operates: A buyer visits your storefront hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. They select a Notion template and pay in crypto via NOWPayments. The payment triggers a webhook that verifies the transaction on-chain. Once confirmed, a Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script automates the delivery process. The template file is pulled from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and sent to the buyer’s email or download link. The order details are logged in Supabase or Google Sheets for your records. Every step is automated. Every tool is free or low-cost. The entire process runs without you lifting a finger — and without relying on any third-party platform.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell Notion templates, courses, ebooks, or other digital products, this infrastructure gives you the tools to collect payment and deliver products automatically. It’s also for creators who value sovereignty. You own the codebase. You control the data. You decide the pricing. No platform fees. No revenue sharing. No KYC requirements. This isn’t a workaround for payment rejection — it’s a permanent solution built on infrastructure you own.
Sovereign commerce stacks give you infrastructure ownership, not platform dependency.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver your Notion template files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no buyer account required. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. Together, they form a stack that’s lightweight, scalable, and fully sovereign. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely — no subscriptions, no hidden costs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys in 48 hours and includes GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments integration. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and advanced email configuration. For full control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates for instant deployment. Once deployed, load your Notion templates, set your prices in USD, and start selling. The stack handles the rest — from payment verification to file delivery. You focus on creating. The infrastructure handles the commerce.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell Notion templates without Stripe or PayPal, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This infrastructure automates payment verification and file delivery, giving you full control over your sales process.
NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee and no buyer KYC required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for managed deployment, or Complete Builder Kit ($197) for full DIY control. 2. Provide your Notion template files and product details. 3. Select your preferred crypto networks (BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees). 4. COREMERCH deploys your stack within 48 hours. 5. Test the payment and delivery process end-to-end. 6. Launch your storefront and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack include managed deployment. COREMERCH handles the setup, and you receive a fully operational store. The Complete Builder Kit requires basic technical skills but includes full documentation.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need to host my Notion templates myself?
Yes, but the stack includes free hosting options like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Your files are delivered automatically once payment is verified.
Can I sell products other than Notion templates?
Absolutely. The stack works for ebooks, courses, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Any digital product can be automated for delivery.
What happens after deployment?
You own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access. You manage your store, update products, and collect revenue directly. No ongoing fees or subscriptions.
Deploy once, own forever — no subscriptions, no hidden costs, no middlemen.
Complete Builder Kit — $197. All 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. Everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Instant download. Worth $348 separately.
